# Acme Privacy Policy

*Last updated: 1 January 2026*

This policy explains what personal data Acme collects, why, and what you can do about it.

This policy is split into sections:

- [What we collect](#what-we-collect)
- [How long we keep it](#how-long-we-keep-it)
- [Your rights](#your-rights)

## What we collect

We collect only what we need to provide the service.

### Account data

When you sign up, we ask for:

- your name
- your email address
  - and, if you choose, a second one

### Usage data

We record which features are used, never what you write with them.

How long we keep it
-------------------

| Data | Kept for |
| --- | --- |
| Account data | While the account is open |
| Usage data | 12 months |

## Your rights

1. You can ask for a copy of your data.

   We answer within one month.

2. You can ask us to correct it.
